plan: [ This is a sealed-bid, second-price (Vickrey) auction with independent private values. With 3 bidders and one round, the dominant strategy is to bid my true value: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ strategies. Overbidding risks winning and paying more than my value if the second-highest bid exceeds it; underbidding sacrifices profitable wins. No history to exploit this round; values are redrawn independently. Therefore, I will bid exactly my value, $21. ]
